brainstem.name: Brainstem
brainstem.definition: The brainstem comprises the midbrain, pons and medulla oblongata.

caudate-nucleus.name: Caudate nucleus
caudate-nucleus.definition: The caudate nucleus is an elongated arched mass of grey matter closely related to the lateral ventricle throughout its length.

cerebellum.name: Cerebellum
cerebellum.definition: The cerebellum occupies the posterior cranial fossa below the tentorium cerebelli.

cerebral-cortex.name: Cerebral cortex
cerebral-cortex.definition: The cerebral cortex is the layer of grey matter covering the surface of the cerebral hemispheres, thrown into folds forming the gyri, separated by sulci.

cerebral-white-matter.name: Cerebral white matter
cerebral-white-matter.definition: The white matter of the cerebrum consists of myelinated fibres: projection, commissural and association.

corona-radiata.name: Corona radiata
corona-radiata.definition: The corona radiata is the fan-shaped mass of projection fibres passing between the internal capsule and the cerebral cortex.

corpus-callosum.name: Corpus callosum
corpus-callosum.definition: The corpus callosum is the great transverse commissure uniting the cerebral hemispheres.

fornix.name: Fornix
fornix.definition: The fornix is a longitudinal, arch-shaped lamella of white substance situated below the corpus callosum, consisting of two symmetrical bands, one for either hemisphere.

fourth-ventricle.name: Fourth ventricle
fourth-ventricle.definition: The fourth ventricle lies between the pons and medulla in front and the cerebellum behind.

frontal-lobe.name: Frontal lobe
frontal-lobe.definition: The frontal lobe lies in front of the central sulcus and above the lateral fissure.

globus-pallidus.name: Globus pallidus
globus-pallidus.definition: The globus pallidus is the medial, paler part of the lentiform nucleus.

hippocampus.name: Hippocampus
hippocampus.definition: The hippocampus is a curved elevation of grey matter in the floor of the temporal horn of the lateral ventricle.

insula.name: Insula
insula.definition: The insula is the cortex buried in the depth of the lateral fissure, covered by the opercula.

internal-capsule.name: Internal capsule
internal-capsule.definition: The internal capsule is a broad band of white matter between the caudate nucleus and thalamus medially and the lentiform nucleus laterally.

lateral-ventricle.name: Lateral ventricle
lateral-ventricle.definition: The lateral ventricles are two irregular cavities within the cerebral hemispheres, communicating with the third ventricle through the interventricular foramina.

occipital-lobe.name: Occipital lobe
occipital-lobe.definition: The occipital lobe forms the posterior extremity of the cerebral hemisphere, behind the parieto-occipital sulcus.

parietal-lobe.name: Parietal lobe
parietal-lobe.definition: The parietal lobe lies behind the central sulcus and in front of the parieto-occipital sulcus.

putamen.name: Putamen
putamen.definition: The putamen is the outer and larger part of the striatum, separated from the globus pallidus by a lamina of white matter.

subarachnoid-space.name: Subarachnoid space
subarachnoid-space.definition: The subarachnoid space lies between the arachnoid mater and the pia mater and contains cerebrospinal fluid.

temporal-lobe.name: Temporal lobe
temporal-lobe.definition: The temporal lobe lies below the lateral fissure and extends back to the occipital lobe.

thalamus.name: Thalamus
thalamus.definition: The thalamus is a large ovoid mass of grey matter forming much of the lateral wall of the third ventricle.

third-ventricle.name: Third ventricle
third-ventricle.definition: The third ventricle is a narrow median cleft between the two thalami.
